prompt: Why won’t the spare screen help today?
promptZh: 備用螢幕為什麼今天派不上用場？

options.text: Check-in takes place before the training room opens.
options.zh: 報到在訓練室開門前開始。
options.whyZh: 沒有提到訓練室開門時間。

options.text: It cannot show today’s check-in list.
options.zh: 它無法顯示今天的報到名單。
options.whyZh: 對話指出缺少必要支架；沒有說螢幕無法顯示名單。

options.text: Its stand won’t return until after check-in begins.
options.zh: 它的支架要等到報到開始後才會歸還。
options.whyZh: 今天兩點就開始報到，專用支架要等到明天才會歸還。

options.text: The technician needs it for another check-in.
options.zh: 技術人員要把它用在另一場報到。

explanationZh: 今天兩點就開始報到，專用支架要等到明天才會歸還。
evidence: Our reception display cut out twice. Check-in starts at two today. Can we borrow the training room screen? / Its stand won’t be back until tomorrow. That screen needs it. Your laptop can show the list by itself.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Our reception display cut out twice. Check-in starts at two today. Can we borrow the training room screen?
